verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’ĕ·lî·p̄az hat·tê·mā·nî way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Eliphaz the Temanite . . . replied
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO respondeu Elifaz o temanita, e disse:

verses.original: הֶֽחָכָ֗ם יַעֲנֶ֥ה דַֽעַת־ ר֑וּחַ וִֽימַלֵּ֖א קָדִ֣ים בִּטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: he·ḥā·ḵām ya·‘ă·neh ḏa·‘aṯ- rū·aḥ wî·mal·lê qā·ḏîm biṭ·nōw
verses.literal: Does a wise man answer with empty counsel or fill his belly with the hot east wind
verses.literalPt: Porventura proferirá o sábio vã sabedoria? E encherá do vento oriental o seu ventre,

verses.original: הוֹכֵ֣חַ בְּ֭דָבָר לֹ֣א יִסְכּ֑וֹן וּ֝מִלִּ֗ים לֹא־ יוֹעִ֥יל בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḵê·aḥ bə·ḏā·ḇār lō yis·kō·wn ū·mil·lîm lō- yō·w·‘îl bām
verses.literal: Should he argue with useless . . . words or speeches that serve no purpose
verses.literalPt: Argüindo com palavras que de nada servem, e com razões, de que nada aproveita?

verses.original: אַף־ אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְתִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִפְנֵי־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- ’at·tāh tā·p̄êr yir·’āh wə·ṯiḡ·ra‘ śî·ḥāh lip̄·nê- ’êl
verses.literal: But you even undermine the fear of God and hinder meditation before Him
verses.literalPt: E tu tens feito vão o temor, e diminuis os rogos diante de Deus.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְאַלֵּ֣ף עֲוֺנְךָ֣ פִ֑יךָ וְ֝תִבְחַ֗ר לְשׁ֣וֹן עֲרוּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî yə·’al·lêp̄ ‘ă·wō·nə·ḵā p̄î·ḵā wə·ṯiḇ·ḥar lə·šō·wn ‘ă·rū·mîm
verses.literal: For your iniquity instructs your mouth and you choose the language of the crafty
verses.literalPt: Porque a tua boca declara a tua iniqüidade; e tu escolhes a língua dos astutos.

verses.original: יַרְשִֽׁיעֲךָ֣ פִ֣יךָ וְלֹא־ אָ֑נִי וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ יַעֲנוּ־ בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yar·šî·‘ă·ḵā p̄î·ḵā wə·lō- ’ā·nî ū·śə·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā ya·‘ă·nū- ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Your own mouth not mine condemns you your own lips testify against you
verses.literalPt: A tua boca te condena, e não eu, e os teus lábios testificam contra ti.

verses.original: הֲרִאישׁ֣וֹן אָ֭דָם תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ri·yō·šō·wn ’ā·ḏām tiw·wā·lêḏ wə·lip̄·nê ḡə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ ḥō·w·lā·lə·tā
verses.literal: Were you the first man ever born Were you brought forth before the hills
verses.literalPt: És tu porventura o primeiro homem que nasceu? Ou foste formado antes dos outeiros?

verses.original: הַבְס֣וֹד אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּשְׁמָ֑ע וְתִגְרַ֖ע אֵלֶ֣יךָ חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: haḇ·sō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·w·ha tiš·mā‘ wə·ṯiḡ·ra‘ ’ê·le·ḵā ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: Do you listen in on the council of God or limit wisdom to yourself
verses.literalPt: Ou ouviste o secreto conselho de Deus e a ti só limitaste a sabedoria?

verses.original: מַה־ יָּ֭דַעְתָּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע תָּ֝בִ֗ין וְֽלֹא־ עִמָּ֥נוּ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: mah- yā·ḏa‘·tā wə·lō nê·ḏā‘ tā·ḇîn wə·lō- ‘im·mā·nū hū
verses.literal: What do you know that we do not . . . What do you understand that is not clear to us . . .
verses.literalPt: Que sabes tu, que nós não saibamos? Que entendes, que não haja em nós?

verses.original: גַּם־ שָׂ֣ב גַּם־ יָשִׁ֣ישׁ בָּ֑נוּ כַּבִּ֖יר מֵאָבִ֣יךָ יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: gam- śāḇ gam- yā·šîš bā·nū kab·bîr mê·’ā·ḇî·ḵā yā·mîm
verses.literal: Both the gray-haired and the aged are on our side men much older . . . than your father
verses.literalPt: Também há entre nós encanecidos e idosos, muito mais idosos do que teu pai.

verses.original: הַמְעַ֣ט מִ֭מְּךָ תַּנְחֻמ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל וְ֝דָבָ֗ר לָאַ֥ט עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·‘aṭ mim·mə·ḵā tan·ḥu·mō·wṯ ’êl wə·ḏā·ḇār lā·’aṭ ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Are the consolations of God not enough for you even words spoken gently to you
verses.literalPt: Porventura fazes pouco caso das consolações de Deus, e da suave palavra que te dirigimos?

verses.original: מַה־ יִּקָּחֲךָ֥ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּֽמַה־ יִּרְזְמ֥וּן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- yiq·qā·ḥă·ḵā lib·be·ḵā ū·mah- yir·zə·mūn ‘ê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Why has your heart carried you away and why do your eyes flash
verses.literalPt: Por que te arrebata o teu coração, e por que piscam os teus olhos?

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תָשִׁ֣יב אֶל־ אֵ֣ל רוּחֶ֑ךָ וְהֹצֵ֖אתָ מִפִּ֣יךָ מִלִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯā·šîḇ ’el- ’êl rū·ḥe·ḵā wə·hō·ṣê·ṯā mip·pî·ḵā mil·lîn
verses.literal: so that you turn your spirit against God and pour such words from your mouth
verses.literalPt: Para virares contra Deus o teu espírito, e deixares sair tais palavras da tua boca?

verses.original: מָֽה־ אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־ יִזְכֶּ֑ה וְכִֽי־ יִ֝צְדַּ֗ק יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: māh- ’ĕ·nō·wōš kî- yiz·keh wə·ḵî- yiṣ·daq yə·lūḏ ’iš·šāh
verses.literal: What is man that he should be pure or one born of woman that he should be righteous
verses.literalPt: Que é o homem, para que seja puro? E o que nasce da mulher, para ser justo?

verses.original: הֵ֣ן בִּקְדֹשׁוֹ לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וְ֝שָׁמַ֗יִם לֹא־ זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hên biq·ḏō·šō lō ya·’ă·mîn wə·šā·ma·yim lō- zak·kū ḇə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: If God puts no trust in His holy ones if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes
verses.literalPt: Eis que ele não confia nos seus santos, e nem os céus são puros aos seus olhos.

verses.original: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־ נִתְעָ֥ב וְֽנֶאֱלָ֑ח אִישׁ־ שֹׁתֶ֖ה כַמַּ֣יִם עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ kî- niṯ·‘āḇ wə·ne·’ĕ·lāḥ ’îš- šō·ṯeh ḵam·ma·yim ‘aw·lāh
verses.literal: how much less . . . man who is vile and corrupt who drinks injustice like water
verses.literalPt: Quanto mais abominável e corrupto é o homem que bebe a iniqüidade como a água?

verses.original: אֲחַוְךָ֥ שְֽׁמַֽע־ לִ֑י וְזֶֽה־ חָ֝זִ֗יתִי וַאֲסַפֵּֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḥaw·ḵā šə·ma‘- lî wə·zeh- ḥā·zî·ṯî wa·’ă·sap·pê·rāh
verses.literal: Listen to me and I will inform you I will describe what I have seen
verses.literalPt: Escuta-me, mostrar-te-ei; e o que tenho visto te contarei

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ חֲכָמִ֥ים יַגִּ֑ידוּ וְלֹ֥א כִֽ֝חֲד֗וּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- ḥă·ḵā·mîm yag·gî·ḏū wə·lō ḵi·ḥă·ḏū mê·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: what was declared by wise men and was not concealed from their fathers
verses.literalPt: (O que os sábios anunciaram, ouvindo-o de seus pais, e o não ocultaram;

verses.original: לָהֶ֣ם לְ֭בַדָּם נִתְּנָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־ עָ֖בַר זָ֣ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·hem lə·ḇad·dām nit·tə·nāh hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lō- ‘ā·ḇar zār bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: to whom alone the land was given when no foreigner passed among them
verses.literalPt: Aos quais somente se dera a terra, e nenhum estranho passou por entre eles):

verses.original: כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י רָ֭שָׁע ה֣וּא מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל וּמִסְפַּ֥ר שָׁ֝נִ֗ים נִצְפְּנ֥וּ לֶעָרִֽיץ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- yə·mê rā·šā‘ hū miṯ·ḥō·w·lêl ū·mis·par šā·nîm niṣ·pə·nū le·‘ā·rîṣ
verses.literal: A wicked man writhes in pain all his days only a few years are reserved for the ruthless
verses.literalPt: Todos os dias o ímpio é atormentado, e se reserva, para o tirano, um certo número de anos.

verses.original: קוֹל־ פְּחָדִ֥ים בְּאָזְנָ֑יו בַּ֝שָּׁל֗וֹם שׁוֹדֵ֥ד יְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl- pə·ḥā·ḏîm bə·’ā·zə·nāw baš·šā·lō·wm šō·w·ḏêḏ yə·ḇō·w·’en·nū
verses.literal: Sounds of terror fill his ears in his prosperity the destroyer attacks him
verses.literalPt: O sonido dos horrores está nos seus ouvidos; até na paz lhe sobrevém o assolador.

verses.original: לֹא־ יַאֲמִ֣ין שׁ֭וּב מִנִּי־ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וְצָפוּ ה֣וּא אֱלֵי־ חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ya·’ă·mîn šûb̲ min·nî- ḥō·šeḵ wə·ṣå̄·p̄ū hū ’ĕ·lê- ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: He despairs of his return from darkness he is marked for the sword
verses.literalPt: Não crê que tornará das trevas, mas que o espera a espada.

verses.original: נֹ֘דֵ֤ד ה֣וּא לַלֶּ֣חֶם אַיֵּ֑ה יָדַ֓ע׀ כִּֽי־ נָכ֖וֹן בְּיָד֣וֹ יֽוֹם־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: nō·ḏêḏ hū lal·le·ḥem ’ay·yêh yā·ḏa‘ kî- nā·ḵō·wn bə·yā·ḏōw yō·wm- ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: He wanders about as food for vultures he knows . . . . . . the day of darkness is at hand
verses.literalPt: Anda vagueando por pão, dizendo: Onde está? Bem sabe que já o dia das trevas lhe está preparado, à mão.

verses.original: יְֽ֭בַעֲתֻהוּ צַ֣ר וּמְצוּקָ֑ה תִּ֝תְקְפֵ֗הוּ כְּמֶ֤לֶךְ׀ עָתִ֬יד לַכִּידֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḇa·‘ă·ṯu·hū ṣar ū·mə·ṣū·qāh tiṯ·qə·p̄ê·hū kə·me·leḵ ‘ā·ṯîḏ lak·kî·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: Distress and anguish terrify him overwhelming him like a king poised to attack
verses.literalPt: Assombram-no a angústia e a tribulação; prevalecem contra ele, como o rei preparado para a peleja;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נָטָ֣ה אֶל־ אֵ֣ל יָד֑וֹ וְאֶל־ שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- nā·ṭāh ’el- ’êl yā·ḏōw wə·’e·lō·ša- šad·dai yiṯ·gab·bār
verses.literal: For he has stretched out his hand against God and has vaunted himself against the Almighty
verses.literalPt: Porque estendeu a sua mão contra Deus, e contra o Todo-Poderoso se embraveceu.

verses.original: יָר֣וּץ אֵלָ֣יו בְּצַוָּ֑אר בַּ֝עֲבִ֗י גַּבֵּ֥י מָֽגִנָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: yā·rūṣ ’ê·lāw bə·ṣaw·wār ba·‘ă·ḇî gab·bê mā·ḡin·nāw
verses.literal: rushing headlong at Him with a thick studded shield
verses.literalPt: Arremete contra ele com a dura cerviz, e contra os pontos grossos dos seus escudos.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כִסָּ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּחֶלְבּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ פִּימָ֣ה עֲלֵי־ כָֽסֶל׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵis·sāh p̄ā·nāw bə·ḥel·bōw way·ya·‘aś pî·māh ‘ă·lê- ḵā·sel
verses.literal: Though his face is covered with fat and his waistline bulges with flesh . . .
verses.literalPt: Porquanto cobriu o seu rosto com a sua gordura, e criou gordura nas ilhargas.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכּ֤וֹן׀ עָ֘רִ֤ים נִכְחָד֗וֹת בָּ֭תִּים לֹא־ יֵ֣שְׁבוּ לָ֑מוֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הִתְעַתְּד֣וּ לְגַלִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kō·wn ‘ā·rîm niḵ·ḥā·ḏō·wṯ bāt·tîm lō- yê·šə·ḇū lā·mōw ’ă·šer hiṯ·‘at·tə·ḏū lə·ḡal·lîm
verses.literal: he will dwell in ruined cities in abandoned . . . houses destined to become rubble
verses.literalPt: E habitou em cidades assoladas, em casas em que ninguém morava, que estavam a ponto de fazer-se montões de ruínas.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יֶ֭עְשַׁר וְלֹא־ יָק֣וּם חֵיל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־ יִטֶּ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ מִנְלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ye‘·šar wə·lō- yā·qūm ḥê·lōw wə·lō- yiṭ·ṭeh lā·’ā·reṣ min·lām
verses.literal: He will no longer be rich his wealth will not endure His possessions will not overspread the land
verses.literalPt: Não se enriquecerá, nem subsistirá a sua fazenda, nem se estenderão pela terra as suas possessões.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יָס֨וּר׀ מִנִּי־ חֹ֗שֶׁךְ יֹֽ֭נַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּ֣שׁ שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת וְ֝יָס֗וּר בְּר֣וּחַ פִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·sūr min·nî- ḥō·šeḵ yō·naq·tōw tə·yab·bêš šal·hā·ḇeṯ wə·yā·sūr bə·rū·aḥ pîw
verses.literal: He will not escape from the darkness the flame will wither his shoots and the breath of God’s mouth will carry him away
verses.literalPt: Não escapará das trevas; a chama do fogo secará os seus renovos, e ao sopro da sua boca desaparecerá.

verses.original: אַל־ יַאֲמֵ֣ן בַּשּׁוֹ נִתְעָ֑ה כִּי־ שָׁ֝֗וְא תִּהְיֶ֥ה תְמוּרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- ya·’ă·mên baš·šō niṯ·‘āh kî·šā- šā·wəʾ tih·yeh ṯə·mū·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Let him not deceive himself with trust in emptiness for emptiness will be his reward
verses.literalPt: Não confie, pois, na vaidade, enganando-se a si mesmo, porque a vaidade será a sua recompensa.

verses.original: בְּֽלֹא־ י֭וֹמוֹ תִּמָּלֵ֑א וְ֝כִפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רַעֲנָֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·lō- yō·w·mōw tim·mā·lê wə·ḵip·pā·ṯōw lō ra·‘ă·nā·nāh
verses.literal: It will be paid in full before his time and his branch will not flourish
verses.literalPt: Antes do seu dia ela se consumará; e o seu ramo não reverdecerá.

verses.original: יַחְמֹ֣ס כַּגֶּ֣פֶן בִּסְר֑וֹ וְיַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ כַּ֝זַּ֗יִת נִצָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·mōs kag·ge·p̄en bis·rōw wə·yaš·lêḵ kaz·za·yiṯ niṣ·ṣā·ṯōw
verses.literal: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes like an olive tree that sheds its blossoms
verses.literalPt: Sacudirá as suas uvas verdes, como as da vide, e deixará cair a sua flor como a oliveira,

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עֲדַ֣ת חָנֵ֣ף גַּלְמ֑וּד וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ אָכְלָ֥ה אָֽהֳלֵי־ שֹֽׁחַד׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ă·ḏaṯ ḥā·nêp̄ gal·mūḏ wə·’êš ’ā·ḵə·lāh ’ā·ho·lê- šō·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: For the company of the godless will be barren and fire will consume the tents of bribery
verses.literalPt: Porque a congregação dos hipócritas se fará estéril, e o fogo consumirá as tendas do suborno.

verses.original: הָרֹ֣ה עָ֭מָל וְיָ֣לֹד אָ֑וֶן וּ֝בִטְנָ֗ם תָּכִ֥ין מִרְמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·rōh ‘ā·māl wə·yā·lōḏ ’ā·wen ū·ḇiṭ·nām tā·ḵîn mir·māh
verses.literal: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil their womb is pregnant with deceit
verses.literalPt: Concebem a malícia, e dão à luz a iniqüidade, e o seu ventre prepara enganos.
